# Third-party libraries used in this folder

- **qrcode.min.js** — [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT License.
- **bcrypt.min.js** — [bcrypt.js](https://github.com/dcodeIO/bcrypt.js) by Daniel Wirtz. Apache License 2.0.
- **md5.min.js** — [blueimp-md5](https://github.com/blueimp/JavaScript-MD5) by Sebastian Tschan. MIT License.

All three are pure client-side JavaScript with no external dependencies, vendored locally so the site keeps working with no backend and no third-party script requests.
